# Problem 1

## Writing a function that, for a fixed group size, randomly draws “birthdays” for each person (computing the probability that at least two people in the group will share a birthday by averaging across the 10000 simulation runs for each group)
```{r}
sim_birthday = function(n) {
  birthday = sample(1:365, size = n, replace = TRUE)
  duplicate = length(unique(birthday)) < n
  return(duplicate)
}
```

## Running function 10000 times for each group size between 2 and 50
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

set.seed(1)

sim_results_df = 
  expand_grid(
    group_size = 2:50,
    iter = 1:10000
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    shared = map_lgl(group_size, sim_birthday)
  ) |> 
  group_by(group_size) |>
  summarize(
    prob_shared = mean(shared)
  )
```

## Making a plot showing the probability as a function of group size
```{r}
sim_results_df |>
  ggplot(aes(x = group_size, y = prob_shared)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Probability that at least two people share a birthday",
    x = "Group size",
    y = "Estimated probability"
  )
```
